The Name That Means Beautiful Quilting & Embroidery! My Grandfather could look at stitches on a drafting table and show my father things about a lace design no one else could see with the naked eye. If you have ever embroidered a beautiful piece of lace only to have it totally disintegrate the first time you laundered it you have experienced what my Grandfather was able to discern by simply looking at a drawing. If you have ever experienced the nightmare of having your machine eat a delicate piece of fabric because the design was not properly digitized, you understand what my Grandfather could see before ever making a single stitch. It was a gift, there is no other explanation, and I and my father have been the beneficiaries of that gift. The Floriani Family Secrets, were really not secrets at all, there were simply skills handed down from an Embroidery Master through his sons and grandson, and everyone reading this story is a beneficiary as well for you have chosen to take advantage of this re-creation of my familys life works.
